question: Should OpenClaw accept this ACP-specific gateway-owned node runtime and command surface now, or pause it in favor of the broader generic long-running node-command architecture tracked elsewhere?
rationale: The PR changes durable runtime storage and the gateway-node trust boundary; automation can identify concrete blockers, but maintainers must choose the permanent product and security architecture before this shape can land.

options.title: Pause until blockers and proof are resolved
options.body: Require SQLite storage, delivery/reconnect/projection/idempotency fixes, conflict resolution, and real paired-node proof before reconsidering this branch.

options.title: Sponsor the ACP-specific runtime shape
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the ACP-specific command surface, then still require the concrete P1 fixes and upgrade/security proof before merge.

options.title: Supersede with a generic node-command path
options.body: Close or replace this branch if the intended direction is the broader streaming node-command primitive tracked by the related open feature request.

recommendation.title: Pause until blockers and proof are resolved
recommendation.body: Require SQLite storage, delivery/reconnect/projection/idempotency fixes, conflict resolution, and real paired-node proof before reconsidering this branch.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest observed history across node command policy and ACP persistence direction, and this decision is broader than one implementation defect.
